title: Study
summary: A short text on a grammar point or a bit of culture, then the examiner's questions.
description: For what is understood rather than drilled: a rule, a conjugation, a custom.

requirements.text: A study lesson needs a title, a text and at least one objective.
A study lesson's page shows its objectives, its text and its sources.
The examiner is given the lesson's text and objectives and asks about every objective.
A study lesson has a text and objectives; the examiner asks one question at a time and gives a line of feedback after each answer.
A lesson built on Wikipedia keeps the examiner's questions to what the lesson and its sources say.
